settings.heading: Frequently asked questions
settings.lede:
Shipping, size, heat, and payment. Care of a piece you already hold lives with Kansa.

Try a question in the interactive FAQ.
settings.notice: The catalogue and checkout are part of a gated exhibition.

settings.heading: How long does delivery take?
settings.text: Delivery dates in the exhibition are examples. A future release would show when its pieces are ready to dispatch and the expected delivery window before payment.

settings.heading: How are shipping rates calculated?
settings.text: In the test journey, Shopify uses the test address and your selected pieces to show example delivery options and charges.

settings.heading: How do I return a piece?
settings.text: Test orders need no parcel sent back. If you are evaluating the returns journey, share your test reference through Contact. See Delivery and returns for the exhibition flow.

settings.heading: How do I choose a size?
settings.text: Diameters are in centimetres on the piece page, next to the material and the heat sources. The title carries the nominal size, such as 26 cm or 28 cm. If two sizes share a form, choose from the selector on that page.

settings.heading: Which heat sources can I use?
settings.text: Each piece lists its heat sources. Induction, gas, and oven are not implied by the metal. Read the specification before the first firing. Kansa can talk through heat and care for a piece you already own.

settings.heading: What is the Kansa page?
settings.text: Kansa is its own room, not a collection. It is the companion for bell bronze and the wider care questions: seasoning, soap, acid, and heat. Open it at /pages/kansa.

settings.heading: How do I try checkout?
settings.text: If the project team has invited you to test checkout, use the test details they supplied. Shopify takes you through delivery, test payment and review.

settings.heading: Where is my order history?
settings.text: Use Account in the header for orders, addresses, and profile. The bag is only the active selection.
